input.title: What should the API do when Redis is unavailable?

nearby.text: Redis is a single point of failure here; if it goes down every request would be rejected.

Plan:
- add limiter middleware
- decide the Redis outage policy
- add tests
Continuing with fail-open behavior and a warning log.

sentences.text: Failing open keeps the public API available during a Redis outage, which the agent flagged as a single point of failure.
